mapper.select: SELECT ap.id AS id, ap.title AS title, CASE WHEN ap.updated_at IS NOT NULL AND ap.updated_at <> '' THEN ap.updated_at ELSE ap.created_at END AS updatedAt, ap.created_at AS createdAt, ap.view AS viewCount, IFNULL(like_count.likeCount, 0) AS likeCount, IFNULL(comment_count.commentCount, 0) AS commentCount, '입양게시판' AS boardType FROM adoptionPost ap LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS likeCount FROM adoptionPostLiked GROUP BY post_id ) AS like_count ON ap.id = like_count.post_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS commentCount FROM adoptionPostComment WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND is_blinded = FALSE GROUP BY post_id ) AS comment_count ON ap.id = comment_count.post_id WHERE ap.user_id = #{userId} AND ap.is_deleted = FALSE AND ap.is_blind = FALSE ORDER BY ap.created_at DESC
